headline: OKJ's 129.8σ volume spike and 15.88% rally dominate the morning, with the company filing a SET clarification the prior day
market_take: Coverage is heavy on small-cap, low-priced names with double-digit moves: TRITN and KC each posted +50.00% on thin volume, while PF and EVER dropped -20.00% and -14.29% respectively. The FOOD sector is the main attention point — OKJ, KSL, RBF, NRF and AQUA are all green, several with unusual-trading flags. PROP is split, with PEACE and SAMCO flagging downside while CGD and EVER drag on volume. Several CONS names are also moving on news flow (TTCL rehab, ITD president resignation) rather than fundamentals.

sector_notes.note: OKJ +15.88% on a 129.8σ volume spike follows its 10-05 SET clarification filing — RM C should verify the response addressed the trading alert list. CPF also flagged a 14.6σ volume spike worth a follow-up.

PF -20.00% coincides with two 10-02 debentureholders' meeting resolutions from G — restructuring/adjournment likely the driver. SAMCO -5.00% on 4.3σ volume and PEACE gap-down -5.16% also bear watching.
TRITN +50.00% is the standout but on vol×0.15 (illiquid) and matches its 5-day gain, so no fresh catalyst. TTCL +33.3% over 5 days follows the 10-05 rehab hearing progress note from K.
GEL is a mixed signal: -20.00% open gap but +25.00% intraday recovery, suggesting high volatility. DCON +6.25% gap-up pairs with its 10-02 PRIN shareholder-rights filing.
SPRIME 6.9σ volume spike (O) and ISSARA -6.42% (O) are the only items; ALLY's 10-02 trust-unit pricing filing from C is a medium-priority follow-up.
TL 10-02 SET clarification on Q2/2026 financials (K, high significance) and SMO 10-01 board chairman resignation (K, high) are the relevant news items even without price action in the digest.
